questions.text: If we recycle more, we ___ less waste.
If I lived near school, I ___ there every day.

exercises.instructions: Write two sentences about environment & our planet that use First and Second Conditional. Include one question and one negative sentence.
exercises.answer_guidance: Check use of First and Second Conditional, spelling, word order, and whether the two sentences are meaningful.

exercises.title: Environment & Our Planet — Reading
exercises.passage: A group of students started a project to reduce plastic waste at school. They placed recycling bins in every classroom and encouraged pupils to reuse bottles. If more students join, the school will produce less rubbish. Their next goal is to save energy by turning off unused lights.

questions.question: What did the students put in classrooms?

exercises.title: Environment & Our Planet — Listening
exercises.script: Host: What would you change about your town? Student: If I were the mayor, I would create more cycle paths. Host: What will you do this year? Student: I will cycle to school if the weather is good.
exercises.audio_source: TTS script. Needs audio recording or speech synthesis integration.

questions.question: When will the student cycle to school?
